description: Golden dataset for QueryMind AI. expected_sql is a reference answer used for result comparison (execution accuracy), not the only correct query. scoring=executes means the business definition is open, so only validity and successful execution are scored.

questions.question: List the names of all product categories.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT category_name FROM categories

questions.question: How many customers are registered?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: Show the first name and email of the customer with customer_id 42.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT first_name, email FROM customers WHERE customer_id = 42

questions.question: Show first name, last name and city of customers from Karnataka.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE state = 'Karnataka'

questions.question: List the product name and price of products costing more than 20000.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 20000

questions.question: How many orders have been cancelled?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: How many payments use the UPI payment method?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE payment_method = 'upi'

questions.question: Show the 5 most expensive products with their prices.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Show the 5 largest orders by total amount: order id and total amount.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Find the number of orders placed in each month.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is the average order value (average total_amount) across all orders?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders

questions.question: What is the total revenue from completed orders? Use the sum of total_amount.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'completed'

questions.question: How many customers are there in each state? Show state and customer count.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY state

questions.question: Compare the number of completed and cancelled orders.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('completed','cancelled') GROUP BY order_status

questions.question: What is the average product price in each category? Show category name and average price.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name

questions.question: Show each product's name together with its category name.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

questions.question: Show pending payments with the customer's first name and last name and the payment amount.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, pay.amount FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pay.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE pay.payment_status = 'pending'

questions.question: How many products are in each category? Show category name and product count.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name

questions.question: Show the top 10 customers by total spending, counting only orders that are not cancelled: customer id, first name, last name and total spent (sum of total_amount).
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Which 10 products have the highest total sales? Calculate sales as the sum of quantity times unit price over all order items; show product name and total sales.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Find the average order value for each state. Show state and average total_amount.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.state, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state

questions.question: What are the total sales per category, computed from order items as quantity times unit price? Show category name and total sales.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: Calculate monthly revenue (sum of total_amount of orders that are not cancelled) for orders placed on or after the date six months before today.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many customers registered in 2024?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE registration_date >= '2024-01-01' AND registration_date < '2025-01-01'

questions.question: Show customers who have never placed an order: customer id, first name and last name.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)

questions.question: List the product name and price of products priced above the average product price.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)

questions.question: Find customers who made more than five orders: customer id and number of orders.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

questions.question: Find the top-selling product in each category by total sales value (quantity times unit price). Show category name, product name and total sales.
questions.expected_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category_id, p.product_id, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.category_id ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS rn FROM sales s) SELECT c.category_name, r.product_name, r.total_sales FROM ranked r JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = r.category_id WHERE r.rn = 1

questions.question: For each month show the number of orders and the running total of orders up to and including that month.
questions.expected_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, order_count, SUM(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM monthly ORDER BY month

questions.question: Which customers placed at least one order in 2026 but none in 2025? Show customer id and first name.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01')

questions.question: What percentage of all orders does each order status represent? Show status and the percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT order_status, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 2) AS percentage FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

questions.question: For each payment method, show the number and the total amount of completed payments.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY payment_method

questions.question: Which month had the highest revenue, counting the total_amount of completed orders? Show the month and the revenue.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
